node_purpose: Independently review ten preserved workpapers across all nine Dell topics using native Counter and Verifier agents; collect exact material corrections for responsible authors, without rerunning research or claiming full-product completion.
input_scale_basis: Start from 6396 catalog characters; all ten workpaper views total141466 characters versus2910278 original notebook characters. Read material sources on demand in16k archived/24k web windows. Own native messages persist;700k approximate request-character ceiling includes tool schemas, excludes non-provider ToolMessage artifacts.
required_outputs: one substantive assessment per actual read paper
material or advisory findings anchored to exact paper/claim/source quotes
unresolved source or execution requests distinguished from public non-disclosure
schema_burden: Seven discovered read-only MCP tools plus submit_case_review. Runtime injects run scope. Local validation checks paper coverage, existing IDs and exact quotes, not a natural-language report template. Max24 model calls/64 tool actions accommodates ten paper reads, selected source checks, arithmetic and self-correction.
materiality_quality_risk: Financial review must inspect issuer/peer/date/period/units/authority and causal inference in context; no source-bound number is promoted to S2, no hidden provider reasoning is transferred to the other reviewer. No-financial-finding is not a product PASS.
comparable_run_evidence: Q8 actual two Pro/low researchers needed6/9calls; previous Q1 full review4calls395606tokens. Large-pack Flash/high next-action truncated32000reasoning tokens while Pro/low returned a valid action. Native whole-case tools/independent contexts tested locally with actual papers/S2 and SDK MockTransport; no whole-case paid quality claim yet.
reasoning_profile: Two independent Pro/low thinking-enabled native create_agent message loops, each persisted by Agent Server; never transfer private reasoning between them. No model fallback or automatic transport retry.
cost_and_latency_estimate: Estimate2-5CNY total for two reviewers,uncertain and not an invoice;monitor actual use/repeated failures. Each may use24model calls64tools with700k approximate request characters32koutput480s. Native tool batches can read multiple papers per turn. Q1 bootstrap fields only preserve existing identity entry and perform no Q1 model call; actual case execution budgets are exclusively case_review_scope. Stop on truncation,limit or unknown outcome; preserve completed sibling checkpoints. No whole research rerun,author repair,report or product PASS in this execution.
